name: A Western woman seated at a table
summary: A drawing of a woman (the head not drawn in) seated at a table, with a forefinger placed between the pages of a book; the shorthand inscription suggests that this may have been a study for a portrait of Mrs Dallas, wife of Alexander Grant Dallas of Jardine, Matheson.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
